quotes.why: Maitreya's own opening homage, the verse p2's salutation answers to — homage to the Mother by the three knowledges. Found by direct search.
Haribhadra's own maṅgala begins the lineage exactly as p2 does — Asaṅga hearing from Maitreya, then Vasubandhu, in the same epithets. Found by direct search.

quotes.text: འཕགས་པའི་ཁོངས་སུ་གཏོགས་པ་ཡི། ། རྣམ་པར་གྲོལ་བར་ཞེས་བྱས་ཀྱང་། ། དེས་བྱས་བྱས་པ་མིན་མཐོང་ནས། ། དབུ་མར་གནས་པའི་བློས་རྣམ་ཕྱེ། ། དེ་ཡི་འོག་ཏུ་རྣམ་གྲོལ་སྡེ། ། དད་པའི་ས་ལ་གནས་པ་ཡིས།
quotes.why: The same maṅgala continues with the two Vimuktisenas in p2's order, and grades them — the Indian model for a lineage verse that also ranks. Found by direct search.
The work of the དབྱིག་གི་གཉེན named in p2's lineage, naming itself གཞུང་འགྲེལ་གནོད་འཇོམས — the text p6 will refuse the status of trail-blazer. Found by direct search.
The work of འཕགས་པ་རྣམ་གྲོལ་སྡེ, third in p2's Indian list, present in this corpus under that name. Found by direct search.
The work of བཙུན་པ་གྲོལ་སྡེ, fourth in p2's list; its title shows it comments on the kārikās where Ārya Vimuktisena's comments on the sūtra. Found by direct search.
The work of སངས་རྒྱས་ཡེ་ཤེས་ཞབས, named beside Haribhadra in p2, and present in this corpus. Found by direct search.
The only བཤེས་གཉེན in this corpus is ཆོས་ཀྱི་, not p2's ཡོན་ཏན་ — the evidence for an identification I cannot settle. Found by direct search.
Why Ngok gets a verse of his own: his title is the pattern of the one p1 announces. Found by direct search.
Ngok's salutation formula is to Mañjuśrī where p2's is to Ārya Maitreya — the same genre, a different dedicatee, and the difference is doctrinally placed. Found by direct search.
Confirms the ཆོས་འབྱོར་དཔལ་བཟང of p2's closing list as his own principal teacher. Found by direct search.
The full name of the Delek from whom he took his first vows, the likeliest referent of p2's བདེ་ལེགས་མཚན་ཅན. Found by direct search.
The biographer's phrase for that lama's kindness matches p2's བཀའ་དྲིན་མཉམ་མེད, which is the ground of the identification. Found by direct search.
